patch_description: Since no code scripts were actually provided in the conversation, I generate a complete, self-contained hybrid adaptive filter that combines the strengths of the requested techniques: (1) a Kalman filter core with adaptive process noise estimated from a sliding window of residuals for responsiveness to non-stationary volatility, (2) a Savitzky-Golay polynomial pre-smoother for multi-scale noise suppression with minimal phase delay (zero-lag symmetric windowing), (3) a trend/slope estimator with hysteresis to suppress false reversals, and (4) a slope-change penalty term so genuine dynamics are preserved while spurious direction flips are damped. The crossover combines deterministic polynomial fitting (cheap, low latency) with stochastic state estimation (adaptive, tracks regime changes), avoiding expensive wavelet/EMD decompositions that add latency. All operations are O(N·W) with small constant factors, suitable for real-time streaming.
